item.tib: 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa
item.skt: Ar+ya d+harma d+hA tu gar+b+ha bi ba ra Na
item.coloph: 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po ye shes snying po dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
